# Ledger — P15.3 Infrastructure map + network explorer

- **Spec:** docs/tickets/P15.3__map-network.md (canonical §§39.3, 39.4, 19.5)
- **Base commit:** 99d246c (branch devin/p15-2-local-dossier)
- **Branch:** devin/p15-3-map-network
- **Scope:** web/ only (TypeScript confined per SIG-ENG-010) + phase-gate docs (ADR/traceability/risk).

## Key design decision (deviation → ADR)
Lighthouse CI budget is a HARD global gate: `resource-summary:script:size` max **0 bytes**,
`total:size`/`total-byte-weight` max **150KB**, applied to every page in dist. The shell is
zero-JS-by-default (ADR-049); archivability is structural. Therefore the interactive maplibre-gl
runtime CANNOT ship (would fail the 0-byte script budget + 150KB total).

ADR-049 (§consequences/revisit) explicitly DEFERS the self-hosted-tiles map renderer (SIG-UI-038)
to P15.3 and keeps the reference map a static, tile-CDN-free SVG + table.

**Resolution (closest faithful alternative):** land the **static-PMTiles serving contract** as a
served, testable artifact — a MapLibre GL style over a self-hosted PMTiles v3 vector source with
OSM attribution, exposed at `/map/style.json` (mirrors the dossier json.ts endpoint pattern) — and
keep the shipped `/map/` page zero-JS (static SVG + tabular equivalent as source of truth). The
OSM attribution renders in the static HTML too (every context incl. print, SIG-GEO-013). All
honest-rendering rules are pure, tested TS logic. Documented in a new ADR; ADR-018/049 referenced.

## Requirements (from spec §§39.3/39.4/19.5 + ticket)
- SIG-UI-016 layers (7 observed) + derived (FOV, coverage) separately toggled + visually distinct (SIG-GEO-006)
- SIG-UI-017 coverage underlay bound to point layer by a SINGLE control
- SIG-UI-018 low-coverage ≠ low-density (desaturation / value-suppressing encoding)
- SIG-UI-019 national-zoom density binning; points only where zoom supports precision (H3 §19.5, SIG-GEO-011)
- SIG-UI-020 no-coordinate assets as jurisdiction indicators, never dropped
- SIG-UI-021 sharing edges as ego-network (matrix + arc alternatives), not national hairball
- SIG-UI-022 network default = ego network with expansion
- SIG-UI-023 inline ER-quality disclosure on EVERY centrality/hub statistic (P6, SIG-IDENT-030)
- SIG-UI-024 three access edge types (configured_access/observed_use/declared_policy) visually
  distinct + independently filterable, not merged by default (§12.2)
- SIG-UI-025 access-path closure: full hop list + per-hop evidence; speculative beyond threshold (SIG-RECON-050, threshold=3)
- SIG-UI-038 self-hosted vector tiles; no hard third-party tile CDN
- SIG-GEO-012 static PMTiles v3; SIG-GEO-013 OSM attribution in every context incl print

## Acceptance criteria
1. Every centrality/hub statistic carries inline ER-quality disclosure (deterministic)
2. Coverage underlay bound to point layer by single control — no points without coverage (deterministic)
3. Low-coverage ≠ low-density (non-colour encoding), vs low-coverage fixture (agentic)
4. No-coordinate assets appear as jurisdiction indicators; none dropped (deterministic)
5. Map has tabular equivalent, network has list equivalent, both no-JS (deterministic)
6. Public map served from static PMTiles, OSM attribution, no hard third-party CDN (deterministic)
7. Phase-gate: CI green; new reqs tested; ADR for deviation; traceability + risk register updated

## Cross-cutting invariants
- No unexplained edges (every access-path hop carries evidence); inference labelled (access-path = L4)
- Additive/back-compat: do not change P15.1 wire names/IDs; new pages additive; reference-map/graph untouched
- Green never for epistemic state (SIG-UI-006); colour never sole channel (SIG-UI-005)
